entries.displayName: Use KeyBurn secret links without printing them
entries.description: How an AI agent opens a KeyBurn secret link on the user's computer with the local osss CLI or MCP server, and uses the secret in a command without the value entering the conversation.
representativeQueries: open a secret link without printing the secret
use an API key someone shared with me in a command
give an AI agent a password without putting it in the chat
share a credential with a self-destructing link

entries.description: Zero-knowledge API for self-destructing secrets. Clients encrypt on their own device; requests carry only ciphertext and tokens derived from a link.
representativeQueries: create an end-to-end encrypted one-time secret link
check whether a shared secret has been opened
destroy a secret link before it is viewed
